name: Lightning Bolt
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Dexterity against a creature within long range. On a win, it takes 2d6 damage. On a loss, it takes half damage.

If the unchecked Condition was Anger, +1d damage.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: You may chain this attack to another creature within short range of the previous target. Roll Spirit vs Dexterity. On a win, the target takes 2d6 damage and you may continue chaining. On a loss, the target takes half damage and the chain ends.

💀: Check a condition.
